reviews.title: Failed to Initialize (DRAM Error) on Compatible DDR5 Platform
reviews.comment: Unfortunately, this memory kit did not work in my system despite extensive troubleshooting. The build is fully DDR5-compatible (AM5 platform), and according to specifications, this RAM should have been supported. I tested each stick individually, tried all recommended DIMM slots, cleared CMOS, allowed extended memory training time, and verified all other components. The system consistently failed to POST and remained stuck on the DRAM debug LED. Installation was proper and other components were confirmed functional. Based on this, the kit appears to have arrived defective or unstable out of the box. Returning for a refund and switching to a different DDR5 kit. Posting this to help others avoid potential compatibility or QC issues
reviews.author: Nir Lev-ran
